_note: Facts checked by hand on each vendor's own site on the date shown. Anything not listed here is 'unknown' on the site. Never add a value without a source URL.

QuickBooks (Intuit).price_note: Plan prices on the pricing page load dynamically and could not be captured on 18 Nov 2026. The page shows a 30-day free trial and 'Calculate and submit CIS' on every plan, including Sole Trader Plus.

affiliate.note: Listed on FlexOffers; the listing states a payout of 16% of online sales and free trials.

Xero.price_note: Ignite plan. Intro offer at check: 90% off for the first 6 months (£1.80/month excl. VAT). The Ignite plan lists 'MTD for Income Tax ready' and CIS calculations.

affiliate.note: Xero runs an affiliate programme via PartnerStack; commission is not published (discussed after joining).

Sage Sole Trader & Landlord Free.price_note: Sole Trader Free: 25 auto-categorised transactions per month, 1 bank account, records landlord income and expenses.

affiliate.note: sage.com links to a 'Sage Affiliate Programme'; terms not yet reviewed.

Sage Sole Trader & Landlord.price_note: Intro offer at check: 90% off for 10 months (£0.70/month excl. VAT), then £7/month.

affiliate.note: sage.com links to a 'Sage Affiliate Programme'; terms not yet reviewed.

FreeAgent.price_note: Prices for UK sole traders and unincorporated landlords. Intro offer at check: 50% off for the first six months. 30-day free trial.

affiliate.note: No public affiliate programme found. FreeAgent's customer referral scheme gives the new customer a 10% discount, not a cash commission.

FreeAgent for free with Mettle, NatWest.price_note: Free while you keep a NatWest, Royal Bank of Scotland or Ulster Bank business current account, or a Mettle account with at least one transaction a month.

Zoho.price_text: Free plan; paid from £10/month billed annually
Zoho.price_note: Zoho Books Free plan is £0. Its MTD page says sole traders and landlords can manage MTD obligations for free. Standard plan is £10/org/month billed annually (£12 monthly).

affiliate.note: Zoho Affiliate Program: 15% commission on qualified sales for the first 12 months (standard tier).

Coconut.price_note: MTD Bridging plan £49.99/year (quarterly updates from a spreadsheet; year-end submission is a £49.99 add-on). MTD filing plan £12.99/month or £129.99/year. 14-day free trial.

Coconut Free.price_note: HMRC lists a free Coconut product; its limits were not checked.

Clear Books Free.price_note: Sole Trader Free, Property Free and Foreign Property Free (one property) plans at £0.

Clear Books.price_note: Sole Trader £5/month, Property £5/month, Sole Trader Plus (VAT-registered) £15/month, all excl. VAT. 30-day free trial.

Acorah Software Products Ltd (TaxCalc).price_note: TaxCalc MTD Quarterly Filer is aimed at accountants filing for clients from spreadsheets.

VitalTax.price_note: Excel add-in. One NI number £30 + VAT per year, covering all quarterly submissions for that person; unlimited licence £198 + VAT.

Abridge (MTD for Excel/Sheets).price_note: Full MTD Coverage plan: quarterly updates and final declaration, from Excel, Google Sheets or file upload.

Absolute Excel Income Tax Filer.price_note: Price covers 5 National Insurance numbers for a tax year.

My Tax Digital (Free).price_note: Describes itself as free MTD software for Income Tax and VAT, with a bridging mode that imports spreadsheet figures.

TaxPig.price_note: Free Community Edition (£0/month, 50 receipt scans). TaxPig Pro £7.50/month.

RentalBux Free.price_note: Free plan for basic MTD compliance. Joint ownership splits are on paid plans.

GetGround.price_note: MTD for landlords free with GetGround's Basic plan.

Aligned.tax MTD for Spreadsheets.price_note: Filing your own quarterly updates is free for individuals; accountants pay per client from the 2027/28 tax year.

MTD Sheets.price_note: First submission free, then £2.99 per submission (from 49p each in bulk).

PaTMa Property Manager.price_note: Free plan covers 1 rental unit. Pro £15/month including VAT for 5 units (extra units £1.50/month). 14-day Pro trial.

Provestor for Landlords.price_note: DIY plan shown at £69 for the first year with a £99/year regular price. Check VAT basis on the source page.

Taxzap.price_note: For non-VAT-registered sole traders and landlords.

Pandle.price_note: Free Pandle plan; Pandle Pro £5/month + VAT.

Landlord Vision.price_note: Starter plan (4 tenancies) shown at £7.99/month with '60% off for the 2 years', against £19.97. VAT basis not confirmed on the captured page.

Landlord Studio.price_text: Free up to 3 properties + £5 per MTD submission; Pro £12 + VAT/month
Landlord Studio.price_note: MTD Go plan is free for up to 3 properties but charges £5 per MTD tax submission. Pro £12 + VAT/month includes MTD submissions.

IRIS Kashflow.price_note: Intro offer at check: 90% off for 6 months (£1.35/month).
